preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 400.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= xi <= 1000 and -1000 <= yi <= 1000 for xi, yi in nodes)
preconditions.description: All node coordinates must be within the range of -1000 to 1000.
All node coordinates must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not is_valid_binary_tree else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to build a binary root tree, output '-1'.
If a valid binary root tree can be built, output the total length of the arcs with a precision of 1e-6.
